query:
UPDATE collection_definitions
            SET
                deleted_at = NOW(),
                deleted_by = $2,
                delete_reason = $3,
                revision = revision + 1,
                etag = concat('collection:', id::text, ':v', revision + 1),
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $1
              AND deleted_at IS NULL
              AND ($4::bigint IS NULL OR revision = $4)
            RETURNING
                deleted_at AS "deleted_at!",
                contract_version,
                revision,
                etag
